issue.title: Capture alias typing tips
issue.description: When Bryan Shift-types a capture sigil that an unshifted alias key would have typed at that exact spot, the list or picker the sigil opens shows one bob-proved "Next time" line in its first frame. The tip fades as the alias becomes habit, and it never slows or changes capture.

mac-tip-core verified: CaptureModels decodes sigil_alias_tip/where/reportsSigilAliasTips/alias, CaptureAliasTip lessons/presentation/policy/session/ledger plus 36 CaptureCoreTests all pass on macOS (runs 42666602607/42666675195) and portable-check green on athena (2381 tests, 0 failures, 1 pre-existing skip); exact-SHA macOS gate red only on pre-existing record-preview timeouts (reproduce on clean base 90fa59d) and one flaky 200ms-sleep separator assertion, both recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: add the alias and sigil_alias_tip fields to the capture-rewrite row in docs/reference/json-outputs.md — skipped here because that page is already over the 6000-word reference cap (bob-cli-h9); do it once the page is under budget.

bob capture-rewrite now stamps every forward sigil alias with an AliasId and emits alias (on expand_sigil_alias) and sigil_alias_tip (object or explicit null; absent without --cursor or when changed) in JSON, plus one dim tip line in human output. New src/native/capture_language/alias_tip.rs runs the whole rewrite_draft pipeline per candidate key; tipped vs untipped is an exhaustive match. Verified: just test (6029 lib + 3416 cli pass), just lint (clippy gate clean, no new warnings), just docs-gen, just docs-build (strict); just docs-check fails only on 5 reference pages over the 6000-word budget that this change does not touch; the checkout build answers the documented JSON for the draft "Buy milk" plus a trailing at-sign. Two plan negatives do not hold because the forward rewrite proves them true, so they are pinned as positives: the draft "cash+goog-exit +" tips parent_task (a spaced comma still aliases plus), and the drafts "=#" and "[[folder#" tip hash_menu with keys limited to backslash (slash stays literal there; where is omitted). Mac phases should expect keys to be a subset of the candidates and where to be optional.
